src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                rr,cc=q.pop(); comp.append((rr,cc))
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                    if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and grid[nr][nc]!=bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
            comps.append(comp)
    template=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in template); r1=max(r for r,c in template)
    c0=min(c for r,c in template); c1=max(c for r,c in template)
    shape=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    anchors=[comp[0] for comp in comps if len(comp)==1 and comp is not template]
    for ar,ac in anchors:
        top=ar-(r1-r0)//2; left=ac-(c1-c0)//2
        for dr,row in enumerate(shape):
            for dc,v in enumerate(row):
                rr,cc=top+dr,left+dc
                if v!=bg and 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
'''
